title: The concurrency test passes on every completed full-suite run
statement: On Windows 11 with Node v24.18.0, running `node --test` over the full suite, the separate-process concurrency test passes on every completed run. One failing completed run falsifies this.
notes: Split from AST-0002 on 2026-08-18 (#101), then made precise the same day (#102). The first wording said 'passes reliably under full-suite parallel load', which is a statistical claim permitting some failure rate — a single failure cannot contradict it. Stated universally, EVD-0003 refutes it exactly. If a rate is wanted later it needs a sample size and an acceptable threshold, and that is a different assertion with different evidence.
